config: timeoutMs was ACCEPTED, now REJE.claim: JSON cannot transport Infinity, so an over-the-wire config cannot produce this input: JSON.stringify turns it into null and JSON.parse of Infinity throws.
NaN was already rejected by both versions, so the new finiteness rule only changes the Infinity case.

signup: website accepted, but the PARSED.claim: A trailing newline behaves the same way and both versions accept the input, so this is a stored-value difference rather than a verdict difference: the oracle keeps 20 characters, main stores 19.
URLs without surrounding whitespace are stored identically by both versions, so the change is limited to padded input.
